title: AI Ready Architecture Catalog

mcp.note: The 2026-07-28 revision uses a stateless protocol core, header-based routing, cache hints, Multi Round-Trip Requests, and an extensions model. Check the official specification before implementation because MCP is evolving quickly.

tracks.title: System Boundaries
tracks.goal: Separate model decisions from deterministic application logic, data, state, authorization, and transaction control.

tracks.title: Data and RAG
tracks.goal: Use current or private evidence with explicit source ownership, permissions, retrieval tests, and provenance.

tracks.title: Tools and MCP
tracks.goal: Connect models to external systems through small contracts, clear permissions, safe retries, and reusable MCP interfaces only where reuse creates value.

tracks.title: Agent Architecture
tracks.goal: Use adaptive loops only when changing evidence makes a fixed workflow insufficient.

tracks.title: Evals and Reliability
tracks.goal: Turn retrieval, model, tool, agent, safety, latency, and cost quality into regression tests and release gates.

tracks.title: Security and Governance
tracks.goal: Treat external content as untrusted data and keep identity, permissions, secrets, approvals, and lifecycle governance outside model control.

tracks.title: Build and Operate
tracks.goal: Move from a demo to a versioned, observable, budgeted, recoverable service.

decision_matrix.rule: Use RAG or direct retrieval before fine-tuning. Keep source IDs, validity metadata, permissions, and citations.

decision_matrix.need: Exact current fact from an external system
decision_matrix.rule: Use a typed read tool instead of asking the model to remember or infer the fact.

decision_matrix.need: Deterministic action in an external system
decision_matrix.rule: Use a typed tool contract. Validate input, output, authorization, and business preconditions outside the model.
Use MCP when shared discovery, contracts, governance, and observability create real reuse. Do not wrap every API only because MCP exists.
Start deterministic. Add model decisions only at uncertain steps.

decision_matrix.need: Known set of possible workflows but messy input
decision_matrix.rule: Use one model decision to route to a known path, with a fallback for uncertain routing.
Use an agent loop with read-tool allowlists, budgets, explicit stop states, tracing, and escalation.
Separate investigation, prepared change, validation, approval, and idempotent execution.

decision_matrix.need: Change style, format, or simple behavior
decision_matrix.rule: Improve instructions, examples, schemas, and evals before considering fine-tuning.

decision_matrix.need: Release a model, prompt, retrieval, or tool change
decision_matrix.rule: Run critical golden cases and operational budgets before production rollout.

production_rules: Separate model reasoning from authorization decisions.
Read-only tools are the default; write tools need narrower scopes and stronger controls.
Never treat retrieved or tool-returned text as trusted instructions.
Make write operations idempotent where possible and use business keys or request IDs.
Bind approval to the exact prepared action, target object, evidence, precondition, approver, and expiry.
Log trace ID, model and prompt version, tool name, sanitized arguments, evidence IDs, result status, latency, and stop reason.
Test timeouts, partial results, duplicate requests, stale data, denied permission, malformed output, prompt injection, and budget exhaustion.
Version prompts, tool schemas, retrieval configuration, datasets, evals, and policy with the application.
Define quality, latency, cost, step, and concurrency budgets before production rollout.
Plan degraded behavior and rollback for model, prompt, retrieval, tool server, and policy changes.

data_artifacts.purpose: Reusable architecture patterns with use conditions, controls, failure modes, and graph links.
Architecture decision and failure-path cases for regression testing and learning.

hands_on_labs.title: SAP Diagnostics MCP
hands_on_labs.build: Inspect and extend synthetic read-only SAP-like tools and resources.

hands_on_labs.title: RAG with Evals
hands_on_labs.build: Index a synthetic policy corpus, answer with citations, compare retrieval methods, and test against a golden dataset.

hands_on_labs.title: Agent with Approval
hands_on_labs.build: Create an operations assistant that investigates with read tools and can execute a prepared change only after approval.

hands_on_labs.title: Production Readiness
hands_on_labs.build: Add version metadata, traces, eval gates, failure policy, secrets, budgets, degraded modes, and rollback.
